projection.purpose: evidence-checked presentation projection; not a PRF canonical root

economics.unit: local controlled fixture-token units; not USDC or a currency valuation

portableBundle.scope: offline indexed artifact integrity and cross-link checks

proof.scope: retained local Foundry proof/admission run; not re-executed by the site

transactionCallLabels.note: Where script broadcast labels differ from forensic call labels, exact receipt hashes and emitted events/logs anchor the displayed observation.

steps.title: Shortfall source and reserve
steps.narration: The controlled request totals 100 units. The local reserve holds 80, including 10 protected; 70 are available.

verificationResults.scope: witness, manifest, operation, configuration and reserve facts agree

steps.title: Pro-rata / Pro-Rata V2 allocation
steps.narration: The committed requests project to Alice 35, Bob 21, Carol 14 from 70 available units. A calculation alone does not move capital.

verificationResults.scope: pro-rata shares reconstruct exactly to the admitted total

steps.title: Deploy the protected dependencies
steps.narration: 24 successful receipts deployed the contracts named in this operation manifest on local Anvil.

verificationResults.scope: deployment addresses, transaction hashes, signers, chain IDs and receipts cross-link

steps.title: Verify and admit the proof
steps.narration: The retained Foundry run reports the real successor Groth16 proof passing the deployed verifier/admission path. This website does not execute SP1 or verify the proof itself.

verificationResults.scope: fixture reports real Groth16 admission; not re-executed by this site
admission event is in the receipt bound to the operation evidence

steps.title: Prepare and register the operation
steps.narration: The retained assurance and ratification records bind the operation to its prepared identity before funding.

verificationResults.scope: prepared-operation and registration receipt records bind to the same operation

steps.title: Ratify and fund the allocator
steps.narration: The protected operation moved exactly 70 fixture-token units from reserve to allocator. 10 protected units remained in reserve.

verificationResults.scope: ERC-20 transfer log and before/after custody agree

steps.title: Activate entitlements
steps.narration: Activation bound the logical table. Liability changed from zero to 70; token custody did not move.

verificationResults.scope: activation evidence cross-links the funding evidence and liability state

steps.title: Alice withdraws 35
steps.narration: Alice received 35 local fixture-token units in a successful local receipt.

verificationResults.scope: beneficiary, amount, receipt context and token Transfer log agree

steps.title: Bob withdraws 21
steps.narration: Bob received 21 local fixture-token units in a successful local receipt.

verificationResults.scope: beneficiary, amount, receipt context and token Transfer log agree

steps.title: Carol withdraws 14
steps.narration: Carol received 14 local fixture-token units in a successful local receipt.

verificationResults.scope: beneficiary, amount, receipt context and token Transfer log agree

steps.title: Reconcile custody and obligations
steps.narration: All 70 funded units were paid to the three fixture beneficiaries. 10 protected units remain in reserve. 30 of the original 100 requested units were unmet and never became funded liabilities.

verificationResults.validator: portable bundle verifier and site reconciler
verificationResults.scope: payouts, custody and liability close to the funded amount
